name: sku-margin
description: Calculate product margins, unit economics and SKU profitability for ecommerce sellers: profit margin per SKU, measured as contribution margin after product costs, returns, fees and ad spend. Use when you ask “can I afford this discount?”, “which products still make money after ads?” or “why do my Amazon seller or Shopify reports disagree?” Compares your proposed prices, discounts and ad budgets, with break-even points and ACoS where the numbers allow, using pasted tables or readable exports. Shows formulas, source rows and missing costs. Shared costs need a stated split. Fee terms and tax treatment come from your inputs or are shown as labelled assumptions. No store connection or paid API is needed.
